story_title: As an Event Coordinator, I want to view outstanding event arrangements so that I know what still needs to be completed before the event can be confirmed

acceptance_criteria.text: The system displays outstanding venue arrangements.

Given an event has more than one venue booking, when arrangements are displayed, then each venue booking is listed separately with its own status (see: Request More Than One Venue for an Event, SPM-81).
The system displays outstanding equipment arrangements.

Given a venue booking or equipment reservation is flagged for review, when arrangements are displayed, then it is shown as outstanding, with why it was flagged, until the Coordinator resolves it (see: Review Flagged Arrangements, SPM-68).
The system displays other required planning items, including registration setup that is enabled but incomplete (see: Configure Event Registration, SPM-64).

The Operational Safety Check is displayed as a required item, showing whether it is not yet submitted, awaiting review, approved, or returned with changes or a rejection (see: Submit Event for Operational Safety Check, SPM-86).
Completed arrangements are distinguishable from outstanding ones.

The assigned Coordinator can mark an arrangement as not required for this event (e.g. an event that needs no equipment, or an unfulfilled equipment item agreed with Technical Support Staff to be non-essential), and can reverse that decision.
The Operational Safety Check cannot be marked as not required.
An arrangement marked as not required is shown as such and is distinguishable from both completed and outstanding arrangements.
The Coordinator can identify which arrangements are preventing confirmation; arrangements marked as not required do not prevent it.

test_cases.title: Every venue booking, equipment line and the safety check are listed with their own status, and Confirm names what is outstanding
test_cases.preconditions: The SPM-33 fixtures are loaded (npm run fixtures:spm33). 'SPM33 Two Room Conference' is in Planning, assigned to Daniel Tan, with two venue bookings, Marina Auditorium (Approved) and Orchard Studio (Pending), and two equipment requirements, Handheld Wireless Mic (Reserved) and Audio Mixing Desk (Requested, not yet reviewed by Technical Support). Logged in as Event Coordinator Daniel Tan (daniel.tan@connectsphere.com / password123). Confirmation is refused in this case, so nothing is changed.
steps: Click 'SPM33 Two Room Conference' in the list
test_cases.test_data:
Event: SPM33 Two Room Conference (Planning)
Venue bookings: Marina Auditorium (Approved), Orchard Studio (Pending)
Equipment: Handheld Wireless Mic (Reserved), Audio Mixing Desk (Requested)
Coordinator: Daniel Tan
test_cases.expected_result:
Step 2: The event opens with the status badge 'Planning' and a 'Readiness' tab after the 'Equipment' tab.
Step 3: Six separate items are listed. 'Marina Auditorium' shows 'Approved' and 'Complete'. 'Orchard Studio' shows 'Pending' and 'Outstanding', and says it is still awaiting a decision from Venue Staff. 'Handheld Wireless Mic' shows 'Reserved' and 'Complete'. 'Audio Mixing Desk' shows 'Requested' and 'Outstanding', and says it is not reserved yet. Neither complete item shows 'Outstanding'. 'Registration setup' shows 'Not required' and says 'Registration is not enabled for this event.', with no button. The last item, 'Operational Safety Check', shows 'Not submitted' and 'Outstanding', says the Operational Safety Check has not been submitted yet, and says 'Confirm event does not wait for it yet.' It has no 'Mark as not required' button, although 'Orchard Studio' and 'Audio Mixing Desk' do. The message '2 arrangements still block confirmation' is shown above the list: the safety check is not counted.
Step 6: The event is NOT confirmed. The message 'This event cannot be confirmed yet: Orchard Studio for this event is still awaiting a decision from Venue Staff; Audio Mixing Desk for this event is not reserved yet.' is shown, naming the same two arrangements and neither of the complete ones. The status badge still reads 'Planning'.

open_questions: Written before the code (TDD, 2026-10-08); the code was built to these cases and the automated tests on 2026-10-09. The cases have NOT yet been walked through the running app: the migration 20261010100000_add_arrangement_not_required was applied to the shared database on 2026-10-10, and npm run fixtures:spm33 still has to be run first. Entries marked DECIDED were chosen by the team rather than taken from the story; change them in code and cases together.

RESOLVED 2026-10-09: reviewed for overlap and cut from 19 cases to 14. Five cases repeated another case's steps on the same event and were merged into it, with every check kept: the equipment list and the confirm refusal into SPM-33-TC01; the missing registration item into SPM-33-TC02; the flagged-arrangement confirm refusal into SPM-33-TC05; and the incomplete-registration list into SPM-33-TC12. The fixture event 'SPM33 Registration Incomplete' is no longer needed.

RESOLVED 2026-10-12: AC6 and AC9 are built now that Submit Event for Operational Safety Check (SPM-86) is on main. The Readiness tab lists the Operational Safety Check last, from the event's latest SafetyCheck, as 'Not submitted', 'Awaiting review', 'Approved', 'Changes requested' or 'Rejected'; a check closed by a change (SPM-88) reads 'Not submitted', since it has to be submitted again. It never has a 'Mark as not required' button, and the server refuses to mark it (SPM-33-TC01, SPM-33-TC06, SPM-33-TC07).

DECIDED 2026-10-08 (Kristen): what can be marked as not required (AC8). Any single venue booking, any equipment line and the registration setup. An event (or a session) with no pending or approved booking that is still required shows 'No venue booked', and that can never be marked as not required (SPM-33-TC02, SPM-33-TC11).

DECIDED 2026-10-08 (Kristen): what Confirm enforces in this story (AC11). Confirm refuses on every arrangement the Readiness tab shows as outstanding: an unbooked or pending venue, equipment that is neither Reserved nor Partially fulfilled, a flagged booking or equipment reservation, and incomplete registration setup. Arrangements marked as not required do not block. The safety check does not block Confirm in this story; that gate stays with Resolve Safety Check Outcome (SPM-88).

RESOLVED 2026-10-10 (Kristen), replacing the decision of 2026-10-08: equipment Technical Support could only partly reserve (Partially fulfilled) counts as held, as Submit Event for Operational Safety Check (SPM-86) decided on 2026-10-09, so Submit and Confirm never disagree. It shows as 'Complete' on the Readiness tab with its own status 'Partially fulfilled' and cannot be marked as not required (SPM-33-TC13). Confirm Event's SPM-34-TC05 is therefore unchanged. One SPM-34 message did change: SPM-34-TC07 now names the venue, 'Orchard Seminar Room for this event is still awaiting a decision from Venue Staff'.

DECIDED 2026-10-08, from the design not the story: the screen is the event's Readiness tab (S-18 in UI_DESIGN.md), at /events/<reference>/readiness, shown after the Equipment tab. Only coordinators have it. Any coordinator can view it; only the assigned one can mark arrangements. Every other role sees 'You don't have access to this event.' (the Equipment tab's wording).

DECIDED 2026-10-08, not in the story: arrangements can be marked as not required, or as required again, only while the event is in Planning. On a Confirmed event, reversing a decision would leave a confirmed event with something outstanding (SPM-33-TC15). The server's refusal reads 'Arrangements can only be marked as not required while the event is in Planning.'

DECIDED 2026-10-08, not in the story: only an outstanding arrangement offers 'Mark as not required'. A complete one (an approved booking, reserved equipment) has nothing to waive; to drop it the Coordinator withdraws the booking or removes the requirement. The server's refusal reads 'Only an outstanding arrangement can be marked as not required.'

DECIDED 2026-10-09 (Kristen): who marked an arrangement as not required, and when, is recorded and shown on the item: 'Marked as not required by Daniel Tan on 8 Oct 2026, 11:00' (SPM-33-TC08, SPM-33-TC15). The customer briefing asks for it: 'Significant actions are recorded, including who performed the action and when it occurred' (Activity History), 'ConnectSphere should be able to determine what was changed, who changed it, and when' (8f Auditability, and answer #14). Reversing is stamped the same way, so the record is the latest decision on each arrangement, not a full history; answer #96 says a complete audit-history function is not required for Release 1. Marking still takes one click with no confirmation dialog, and no reason is asked for: none of the documents require one. Say so if the team wants a reason kept.

DECIDED 2026-10-08, wording: the state labels 'Complete', 'Outstanding' and 'Not required'; the buttons 'Mark as not required' and 'Mark as required'; the summary '2 arrangements still block confirmation', '1 arrangement still blocks confirmation' and 'Nothing is blocking confirmation'; the items 'No venue booked' and 'Registration setup'; and the reasons 'is still awaiting a decision from Venue Staff', 'is not reserved yet', 'is flagged for review: <why>', and, for registration, SPM-64's own wording (see the 2026-10-12 entry below).

DECIDED 2026-10-08, not in the story: what is listed. One item per pending or approved venue booking (a rejected or cancelled request is not listed), one item per equipment line, and 'Registration setup' only while registration is enabled. An event with registration switched off has no registration item (SPM-33-TC02), although the mockup design/mockups/Readiness.dc.html shows one reading 'Not required'. The mockup's 'Request reviewed and approved' and 'Technical support assigned' items are not listed either: nothing assigns technical support staff to an event yet.

DECIDED 2026-10-08, not in the story: the Readiness tab has no 'Confirm event' button, although the mockup shows one. Confirming stays on the Overview (SPM-34), which is why SPM-33-TC01 and SPM-33-TC13 go back to it.

RESOLVED 2026-10-12: the fixtures are scripted. scripts/seed-spm33.ts (npm run fixtures:spm33) creates the 16 'SPM33 ...' events on 12 Jul-2 Aug 2027, raised by Rachel Ng and assigned to Daniel Tan (one to Priya Raj), with their sessions, venue bookings, equipment lines and safety checks; the same events are at the end of prisma/seed.ts without them.

For Kayal (SPM-81) and Janelle (equipment, SPM-86): the migration 20261010100000_add_arrangement_not_required adds not_required, not_required_by and not_required_at to venue_bookings and to equipment_requests, which are their tables. It was applied to the shared database on 2026-10-10 and only adds columns. SPM-81's 'Request booking' flow is checked from the Readiness tab by SPM-33-TC04.

To check when Review Flagged Arrangements (SPM-68) is built: AC4 says a flagged arrangement is outstanding 'until the Coordinator resolves it'. Resolving is SPM-68's; in this story the only way a flagged arrangement stops blocking is to be marked as not required. Is that an acceptable way to resolve a flagged booking, or should a flagged arrangement not offer 'Mark as not required'?
